name: Audienceful
line: Newsletter publishing, marketing automations and transactional email.

free.text: Free up to 1,000 contacts; 100 transactional sends/month

cells.api: Yes; sending needs a valid payment method

subs.math: The free plan's campaign allowance is not known. Essentials costs $37.50 a month, but its campaign limit is not stated.
The Essentials plan for 6,000 contacts costs $70 a month. It is not known whether you can email the full list.
The Essentials plan for 10,000 contacts costs $99 a month. It is not known whether you can email the full list.
The Essentials plan for 50,000 contacts costs $320 a month. It is not known whether you can email the full list.

appmail.math: The Essentials plan covers 3,000 app emails a month, with 1,000 stored contacts and no workflow runs.
The Essentials plan covers 10,000 app emails a month, with 1,000 stored contacts and no workflow runs.
The Essentials plan covers 50,000 app emails a month, with 1,000 stored contacts and no workflow runs.
The Essentials plan covers 100,000 app emails a month, with 1,000 stored contacts and no workflow runs.
